body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Digitalfoci expects to launch its three new digital photo frame lineup at upcoming CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA. Suggested price for 15-inch model 'IMT-153' is 399USD, 199 USD for 8-inch 'IMT-083', and 149 USD for 5.7-inch 'IMT-063'.
